e.body:
**Juliette**（GitLab `tomgriffin/juliette`，自述「A Claude Plugin for NY VBC Strategists and Analysts」）是目前见到的**最完整的「单一司法辖区精算 AI 插件」样本**。可核实信息：项目 **2026-05-01 创建、最后活动 2026-05-02**、**★0、无许可证**、**版本 1.1.1**（提交 "Bump version to 1.1.1"）、**文件树实测 274 个条目**（分页 API 100+100+74）、**提交 17 个**、安装方式为 `install-remote.sh` / `install-remote.ps1`（README 给出 `curl -fsSL … | sh` 与 PowerShell `irm … | iex`）。

结构（据 README 与实测文件树）：**① 23 个技能、分 7 个领域**——VBP 设计与认证、**MA 投标（bid）开发**、**风险调整**、**Stars/QARR 质量分析**、**SPARCS 医院对标**、Medicaid 参保、MLTC、**HRSN 投资回报**、**DRG 定价**、rebasing 策略、**MCO 费率设定**、SCN 协调、完整 ACO/IPA 管理，另含 **262 词术语表**、平实语言翻译、记忆持久化与引导上手；**② 8 个实时数据 MCP 服务器**——分别封装 **NYSDOH、CMS、Census、NPPES、NLM VSAC、FDA（openFDA）、CDC（PLACES）**等公共 API（实测目录为 `cdc_places`/`census_data`/`cms_data`/`medicaid_data`/`nppes`/`ny_health_data`/`openfda`/`vsac`）；**③ 权威参考文件**——**NYSDOH 2026 VBP Roadmap 与 7 套 measure set** 的 PDF，以及 **49+ 份随包 CSV/PDF**（费率单元 rate cells、measure sets、MCO 与医疗机构名册、地理对照表、**风险调整因子表**、ACO 治理、分配方法、行为健康危机连续体、孕产妇死亡回顾、癌症登记、HRSN/SDOH 语境）；**④ 评测集**——**15 个测试用例，覆盖技能路由、拒答行为与输出准确性**；另有 `scripts/validators` 与 `evals/regression_results`。

对 RIAA：它的价值**不在「又一个技能库」**，而在三点。**第一，它是「辖区纵深」的极端样本**——池内 AI 技能条目多为**跨市场通用**（[[insurance-skills]]、[[hcls-agent-skills]]、[[dsh-insurance-experts]]），也有单一市场切片（[[indian-health-claims-skill]]、[[non-motor-insurance-product-skill]]），但**把「一个州 + 一个支付制度（Medicaid 价值医疗）」拆到 23 个技能 + 49 份官方文件**的深度，此前没有。**第二，8 个 MCP 数据源本身就是一份可用的数据地图**——即使完全不使用这个插件，**VSAC 值集、NPPES 提供者名录、SPARCS 住院数据、CMS 与 CDC PLACES** 正是美国健康险**风险调整与价值医疗分析的底层数据源清单**，可与 [[icd-hcc-mappings]]、[[hhs-hcc-sql]]、[[cms-open-data]]、[[medicare-claims-pricer]]、[[databricks-medicare-risk-adjustment]]、[[healthcare-mrf-api]] 对照使用。**第三，评测集里明确包含「拒答行为」测试**——这与本 wiki 关注的[[payer-agent-audit]]一类「受监管场景下 AI 该说不」的问题同源，提供了一个**技能库上线前怎么测**的具体做法。

⚠️ **三条必须如实标注的风险**：**①** **★0、无许可证、全部提交集中在 2026-05-01 当天**，此后无活动——属于**一次性发布**，长期维护无保障；**②** 安装方式把远端脚本直接管道给 shell（`curl … | sh`），**执行第三方脚本前应自行审阅**，本词条不对其安全性作任何担保；**③** 它是 **Claude Code/Cowork 生态的插件**，不是通用格式，**与本 wiki 所讨论的其他 harness 不通用**；README 中的能力清单（23 技能、49 文件、15 用例）为**项目自述**，本次核实到文件树与目录结构层面，**未逐份打开 274 个文件，也未运行其评测**。**核实说明**：GitLab 项目元数据、文件树、提交列表与 README 均经 API 实测；**未安装、未运行**。
e.body_en:
**Juliette** (GitLab `tomgriffin/juliette`, self-described as "A Claude Plugin for NY VBC Strategists and Analysts") is the **most complete sample of a single-jurisdiction actuarial AI plugin** encountered so far. Verifiable details: project **created 2026-05-01, last activity 2026-05-02**, **0 stars, no licence**, **version 1.1.1** (commit "Bump version to 1.1.1"), **file tree measured at 274 entries** (paginated API: 100+100+74), **17 commits**, installed via `install-remote.sh` / `install-remote.ps1` (the README gives `curl -fsSL … | sh` and PowerShell `irm … | iex`).

Structure (per the README and the measured tree): **① 23 skills in 7 domain categories** — VBP design and attestation, **MA bid development**, **risk adjustment**, **Stars/QARR quality analytics**, **SPARCS hospital benchmarking**, Medicaid enrolment, MLTC, **HRSN ROI**, **DRG pricing**, rebasing strategy, **MCO rate setting**, SCN coordination, full ACO/IPA management, plus a **262-term glossary**, plain-language translation, memory persistence and guided onboarding; **② 8 live-data MCP servers** wrapping public APIs from **NYSDOH, CMS, Census, NPPES, NLM VSAC, FDA (openFDA) and CDC (PLACES)** (measured directories: `cdc_places`, `census_data`, `cms_data`, `medicaid_data`, `nppes`, `ny_health_data`, `openfda`, `vsac`); **③ authoritative reference files** — PDFs of the **NYSDOH 2026 VBP Roadmap and seven measure sets**, plus **49+ bundled CSV/PDF files** (rate cells, measure sets, MCO and provider rosters, geography crosswalks, **risk adjustment factor tables**, ACO governance, distribution methodology, behavioural health crisis continuum, maternal mortality review, cancer registry, HRSN/SDOH context); **④ an eval harness** — **15 test cases covering skill routing, refusal behaviour and output accuracy**, alongside `scripts/validators` and `evals/regression_results`.

For RIAA: its value is **not "yet another skill library"** but three things. **First, it is an extreme sample of jurisdictional depth** — most AI skill entries in the corpus are **cross-market and general** ([[insurance-skills]], [[hcls-agent-skills]], [[dsh-insurance-experts]]) or single-market slices ([[indian-health-claims-skill]], [[non-motor-insurance-product-skill]]), but **splitting "one state plus one payment regime (Medicaid value-based care)" into 23 skills and 49 official documents** had no precedent here. **Second, the eight MCP data servers are themselves a usable data map** — even without adopting the plugin, **VSAC value sets, the NPPES provider directory, SPARCS inpatient data, CMS and CDC PLACES** are precisely the underlying data sources for **US health-insurance risk adjustment and value-based care analysis**, and can be read alongside [[icd-hcc-mappings]], [[hhs-hcc-sql]], [[cms-open-data]], [[medicare-claims-pricer]], [[databricks-medicare-risk-adjustment]] and [[healthcare-mrf-api]]. **Third, the eval harness explicitly includes "refusal behaviour" tests** — the same concern as [[payer-agent-audit]] in this wiki ("an agent must know when to say no" in a regulated setting), and it offers a concrete answer to how a skill library should be tested before release.

⚠️ **Three risks that must be stated plainly**: **①** **0 stars, no licence, and every commit confined to 2026-05-01** with no activity since — a **one-off publication** with no maintenance guarantee; **②** the install method pipes a remote script straight into a shell (`curl … | sh`), so **review any third-party script before running it** — this entry makes no security claim; **③** it is a plugin for the **Claude Code/Cowork ecosystem**, not a portable format, and **does not transfer to the other harnesses discussed in this wiki**. The capability list in the README (23 skills, 49 files, 15 test cases) is **the project’s own claim**; this check reached the file-tree and directory-structure level, **did not open all 274 files and did not run its evals**. **Verification note**: GitLab project metadata, file tree, commit list and README were all measured through the API; **nothing was installed or executed**.
e.body_hk:
**Juliette**（GitLab `tomgriffin/juliette`，自述「A Claude Plugin for NY VBC Strategists and Analysts」）是目前見到**最完整的「單一司法轄區精算 AI 插件」樣本**。可核實資訊：項目 **2026-05-01 建立、最後活動 2026-05-02**、**★0、無許可證**、**版本 1.1.1**、**文件樹實測 274 個條目**（分頁 API 100+100+74）、**提交 17 個**、安裝方式為 `curl -fsSL … | sh` 或 PowerShell `irm … | iex`。

結構：**① 23 個技能、分 7 個領域**——VBP 設計與認證、**MA 投標開發**、**風險調整**、**Stars/QARR 質量分析**、**SPARCS 醫院對標**、Medicaid 參保、MLTC、**HRSN 投資回報**、**DRG 定價**、**MCO 費率設定**、完整 ACO/IPA 管理，另含 **262 詞術語表**與引導上手；**② 8 個實時數據 MCP 伺服器**——封裝 **NYSDOH、CMS、Census、NPPES、NLM VSAC、FDA、CDC** 等公共 API（實測目錄 `cdc_places`/`census_data`/`cms_data`/`medicaid_data`/`nppes`/`ny_health_data`/`openfda`/`vsac`）；**③ 權威參考文件**——**NYSDOH 2026 VBP Roadmap 與 7 套 measure set**，以及 **49+ 份隨包 CSV/PDF**（費率單元、**風險調整因子表**、地理對照表、ACO 治理等）；**④ 評測集**——**15 個測試用例，覆蓋技能路由、拒答行為與輸出準確性**。

對 RIAA：價值**不在「又一個技能庫」**。**第一，它是「轄區縱深」的極端樣本**——池內 AI 技能條目多為**跨市場通用**（[[insurance-skills]]、[[hcls-agent-skills]]、[[dsh-insurance-experts]]），也有單一市場切片（[[indian-health-claims-skill]]、[[non-motor-insurance-product-skill]]），但**把「一個州 + 一個支付制度」拆到 23 個技能 + 49 份官方文件**的深度此前沒有。**第二，8 個 MCP 數據源本身就是一份可用的數據地圖**——**VSAC 值集、NPPES 名錄、SPARCS 住院數據、CMS 與 CDC PLACES** 正是美國健康險**風險調整與價值醫療分析的底層數據源清單**，可與 [[icd-hcc-mappings]]、[[hhs-hcc-sql]]、[[cms-open-data]]、[[medicare-claims-pricer]]、[[databricks-medicare-risk-adjustment]]、[[healthcare-mrf-api]] 對照。**第三，評測集明確包含「拒答行為」測試**——與 [[payer-agent-audit]] 同源。

⚠️ **三條必須如實標注的風險**：**①** **★0、無許可證、全部提交集中在 2026-05-01 當天**，屬**一次性發布**；**②** 安裝方式把遠端腳本直接管道給 shell（`curl … | sh`），**執行第三方腳本前應自行審閱**；**③** 它是 **Claude Code/Cowork 生態的插件**，**與本 wiki 討論的其他 harness 不通用**。README 的能力清單為**項目自述**，本次核實到文件樹層面，**未逐份打開 274 個文件，也未運行其評測**。**核實說明**：項目元數據、文件樹、提交列表與 README 均經 API 實測；**未安裝、未運行**。
